## User problem / 用户问题

<!-- 谁需要此功能，当前哪个任务难以完成？ / Who needs this, and what task is currently difficult? -->

## Proposed behavior / 建议行为

<!-- 描述最小可用行为，以及它应如何呈现在 UI 或 API 中。 / Describe the smallest useful behavior and how it should appear in the UI or API. -->

## Product boundary / 产品边界

- Does this remain local-first? / 是否仍然坚持本地优先？
- Does it add a provider, external service, tool, plugin, or new permission? / 是否新增服务商、外部服务、工具、插件或权限？
- Does it require new model weights, media, or other separately licensed assets? / 是否需要新的模型权重、媒体或其他单独许可的资源？

## Alternatives and tradeoffs / 替代方案与权衡

<!-- 说明现有变通方案和重要风险。 / Explain existing workarounds and important risks. -->

## Acceptance evidence / 验收证据

<!-- 哪个测试、追踪记录或手动检查可以证明功能有效？ / What test, trace, or manual check would show that the feature works? -->
